# <span id="aanchor289"></span> Measurement Area Editor

The Measurement Area Editor allows you to enter a measurement area that you can then access in areas throughout FLOWCAL, such as the Meter Editor, Quality Source Editor, or Location Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Measurement Area Editor and modify measurement area options:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Measurement Area** in the **Geographic** group.
3.  Select a measurement area from the list and click the **Edit** button.
4.  Update the measurement area data at the bottom of the screen as needed.
5.  Click the **Save** button.

To add a new measurement area:

1.  Click the **New** button.
2.  Enter the measurement area data at the bottom of the screen.
3.  Click the **Save** button. The measurement area will now be available within FLOWCAL.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 363;height: 382;" />

To delete a measurement area:

1.  Select a measurement area and click the **Delete** button.
2.  Select another measurement area to replace the one being deleted for all associated meters, locations, etc., or delete the measurement area without replacing it by selecting "\*Leave Blank".
3.  Click **OK**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 251;height: 142;" />

</div>
